name: academic-figure-generator-skills
description: AI-powered academic figure generation skill pack — parse papers, analyze code repos, plan figures, generate publication-quality prompts with colorblind-safe palettes
author: LigphiDonk

skills.name: Academic Repo Analyzer
skills.description: Analyze deep learning/machine learning code repositories to understand what they do, identify model architecture, core algorithms, tech stack, and key innovations. Generates a "quick understanding document" that can be passed to paper-analyzer.

skills.name: Academic Figure Prompt
skills.description: Generate extremely detailed English prompts for AI image tools to produce top-conference-quality academic figures. Uses classic Okabe-Ito / Nature / CVPR style with 8 preset palettes.

skills.name: Academic Figure Prompt — Modern ML Airy Style
skills.description: Generate prompts for modern ML/RL paper-style figures matching ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML 2024-2025 aesthetics. Pure white canvas, white panels with soft shadow, rounded fonts, pastel token squares, pill-shaped labels.

skills.name: Academic Paper Analyzer & Figure Planner
skills.description: Analyze academic papers to plan which figures to generate. Extracts section structure, identifies figure-worthy content, suggests figure types and count per section.
trigger_phrases: which figures does my paper need

skills.name: Academic Figure Color Expert
skills.description: Academic color palette expert with 9 preset schemes plus colorblind-safe design principles. Helps choose the right palette for your venue and validates accessibility.
